summary: RETEST of iter 30 HIGH bug (silent /api/devices/register on full page reload after 401 identity-reset). FIX VERIFIED PASS on Expo web preview @ 390x844. Playwright E2E flow: (1) fresh context → onboarding-start-button → disclosure-accept-button → apollo-state-label rendered → localStorage 'apollo.device.identity.v2' populated with {deviceId(hex), token(len 43), expiresAt}; exactly 1 POST /api/devices/register during onboarding. (2) POST /api/devices/token/rotate with A's Bearer → 200 (localStorage NOT updated). (3) page.goto('/family') triggers React Query fetches → server returns 401 → client resetDeviceIdentity() called → localStorage 'apollo.device.identity.v2' cleared AND marker key 'apollo.device.identity.reset.v1' persisted (value = 'Apollo needs to re-register this phone…'). (4) Navigating back to Home shows identity-reset-card + identity-reset-why + identity-reset-register button. (5) page.reload() on Home → card STILL visible after boot; ZERO auto POST /api/devices/register observed during the reload window; identity still null; marker still present — this is the specific regression that failed in iter 30 and now passes. (6) Navigation loop /guard → /family → / while in reset state → marker persists across every hop; zero silent registrations; card visible again when back on Home. (7) Tap identity-reset-register → exactly 1 POST /api/devices/register → new deviceId (differs from original) stored in localStorage → marker key removed → card gone from Home; toast copy 'Registered as a new device. Re-pair with family members to share alerts again.' shown. (8) Final page.reload() → no card, zero register calls, identity persists. Fresh-install regression: brand-new browser context still auto-registers exactly once on first onboarding (marker absent, as expected). Total assertions across two runs: 33 pass, 0 fail against the fix (the 3 initial 'card not visible on /family' failures were test-script issues — the card only lives on Home; corrected by navigating to / before assertion). Files touched by fix (already applied by main agent): /app/frontend/src/auth/deviceIdentity.ts (RESET_KEY constant, resetDeviceIdentity writes marker, registerDeviceIdentity clears marker, getIdentityResetReason reads it), /app/frontend/src/store/ApolloContext.tsx (boot IIFE lines 219–228 now checks getIdentityResetReason() before falling through to registerDeviceIdentity(); reRegisterDevice() unchanged but effect chain now correctly clears the marker via registerDeviceIdentity). No deprecated Expo packages introduced. No react-native issues detected in the changed files.
critical_code_review_comments: src/auth/deviceIdentity.ts: marker key 'apollo.device.identity.reset.v1' is versioned (nice — future-proofs a schema change); reset marker written unconditionally in resetDeviceIdentity() and cleared inside registerDeviceIdentity() so success on either the boot path or reRegisterDevice() converges on a clean state.

src/store/ApolloContext.tsx boot IIFE lines 219–228: correctly gates the silent register call behind `const resetWhy = identity ? null : await getIdentityResetReason();` and only falls through to registerDeviceIdentity() when both identity is missing AND no reset marker is present. This is the exact fix recommended in iter 30 RCA.
Boot effect still calls apiPost('/devices/heartbeat', …) only when identity exists — good, no 401 leak from heartbeat during a reset state.

reRegisterDevice() relies on registerDeviceIdentity()'s marker cleanup rather than an extra storage.removeItem() call — DRY, and the ordering (write identity, then remove marker) is race-safe against a concurrent reload because the boot code only re-checks getIdentityResetReason() when identity is missing.

success_rate.frontend: 33/33 assertions PASS across two E2E runs (10/10 in the corrected run; 23/23 non-navigation assertions in the first run)

seed_data_creation: Ephemeral: ~3 devices registered via /api/devices/register (onboarding + one re-register per run). Append-only, no cleanup needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The reset-marker path is now fully wired. If the auth surface changes again, three invariants to keep asserting on web preview (390x844): (a) after a mid-session 401, localStorage 'apollo.device.identity.reset.v1' is set and 'apollo.device.identity.v2' is null; (b) a page.reload() while the marker is set must NOT fire POST /api/devices/register; (c) tapping identity-reset-register must fire exactly ONE POST /api/devices/register and remove the marker. Note that identity-reset-card renders only on the Home screen (app/(tabs)/home.tsx:62), so navigate to '/' before asserting on it — asserting on /family or /guard will falsely fail. Rotation helper: POST {API}/devices/token/rotate with 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' (no body). Fresh-install regression: a brand-new browser context (or window.localStorage.clear()) must still auto-register exactly once during onboarding because the marker is absent by definition on first launch.
rca_of_issue: n/a — bug from iter 30 is fixed as recommended (persistent 'reset marker' in AsyncStorage/localStorage). Verified by 10 targeted assertions plus a full 23-assertion regression flow.
